headline: A huge gain for Kansas City
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw a long pass to T.Thornton for 30 yards, which is a new set of 4 tries for the Chiefs.
who: P.Mahomes and T.Thornton are the key players.
why_it_matters: This is great news because it moves the Chiefs much closer to scoring and increases their chance of winning by 24 percentage points.
